name: dc46_reconciliation_plan_complete
description: DC46-C (ADR-75) planning heartbeat: one count per finished reconciliation planning pass of the processfilelinkrevocations worker, about hourly while FILE_LINK_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_HOURS is above 0. Read by alert policy C. Counts only; extracts nothing from the log entry.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="processfilelinkrevocations" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stdout") AND jsonPayload.message="file-links: reconciliation plan complete"
